### 3. The Māyic-threshold delineation — the eight determinations' mythic recapitulation (Frank-locked)

Frank's notes give the eight determinations a complete mythic recapitulation in one author, with page anchors: `−/−` En-Soph/tohubohu (pp. 18, 106); `0/1` the world parents' separation; `?/!` the coming of light; `−/+` hunger as systole/diastole; `X/x` ego against the unconscious ground; `AM/IS` "I am I" (with Frank's paśu correction — the Bṛhadāraṇyaka passage Neumann quotes at p. 105 shows recognition preceding separation: "I am" is prakāśa's vimarśa before pati/patni, and Neumann collapses prakāśa-vimarśa into ego); `∞/dx` the great round (Mono/Poly pleromatic); `1/0` the hero's descent and return. Frank's lock-gloss: this is the delineation of the Māyic threshold — the first unfolding into differentiation of the `0/1`, the `4+2` (+2) retaining its conditions of transformation and genesis as explicit qualities. Candidate grounding: Argument 13 (tattvic differential field) and Argument 20 (advent) via phylogenetic recapitulation. Open placement question, carried to harmonisation: plate/appendix object vs woven §4 prose register.

### 4. The energetics cap (Frank-locked)

The five-register energetics discipline closed by: the somatic floor (Van Eenwyk's systole/diastole, the gut as the body's torus, hunger/striving at `−/+`) and the physics witnesses (plasma oscillation, magnetic confinement, Floquet-driven systems from Frank's GPT chat logs — witnesses only, never theorem-authority). Frank's user-authoritative stipulation: the torus carries formal reality through all energetic registers (magnetism, Floquet physics). The cap's spine: no register's "energy" is another's substance; the torus is what persists across them (see §14 for the mathematical wing this session added).

### 5. The uroboros-torus-trickster weave (user-authoritative correction, walked across the fourfold)

The uroboros is the torus — the `4+2` — not the sphere or circle; all prior corpus treatments that read the round as sphere/perfect-circle stand corrected. The snake is the trickster precisely because the torus is passed off as the sphere (the Eden-serpent as the same figure in fallen register: the hole traded for the fork). Walked across the ponere/ballein fourfold: **position** — the circle as costume, the sphere's dead arithmetic `(-1)+(+1)=0`; **opposition** — the head/tail hunger axis; **superposition** — self-eating as `(0/1)/(1/0)` made bodily, the mouth as the operative hole; **interposition** — the uroboros as genus-one `4+2`: four explicate twisting field-lines (`#5` the enfolding whole) and two implicates (the magnetic axis + the hole = `#0`). Meta-ballein (metabolism, etymologically) accounted at this register: circulation that nourishes (assimilation/samāveśa) versus Saturn-devouring (the blocked gut as monopoly's metabolism). Register nuance recorded: this ledger's own prior line ("the torus becomes the apt symbol only after this process has been derived... the ouroboros, halo, and eternal-return images give the same operation mythematic bodies") was already toroidal — Frank's correction sharpens that line (adding the trickster's pass-off, the `4+2` explication, and the hole's proper owner) rather than demolishing it; what falls is Neumann's perfection-as-circle-sphere-round and any static "paradox held" reading.

### 6. Māyā is not the hole (user-authoritative correction)

The hole is Paramaśiva/Anuttara, the `#0`, the kṛtṛ pole. Māyā is the formal patterns Śakti's winding makes to reflect back to the hole/prakāśa via vimarśa — the measure-field, not the void it measures around. Śakti has joy/ānanda for Māyā. The plasma log already carried this unknowingly ("the axis the plasma can never occupy" = the Anuttara doctrine in physics vocabulary). Consequence carried through every layer below: wherever the weave says "the hole," its owner is Anuttara; wherever it says "Māyā," it means the winding's pattern-field.

# 6. Ouroboros · torus · trickster — the whole that keeps its hole

**Office:** supporting-visible / deep-bearing project-composed Mytheme with exact Matheme neighbour; historical ouroboros and Neumann source work remain distinct from the project's toroidal appointment.

`[[inherited-corpus-crosswalk/04-MATHEMATICAL-SUBSTRATE|§3 — Mathematical Substrate — Inherited Region Recovery]]` **grounds** the exact torus relation; `[[inherited-corpus-crosswalk/05-PSYCHOID-FLOWERING|§4 — Psychoid Flowering — Inherited Region Recovery]]` **returns** it into individuation and image; `[[THREAD-INTAKE-WHOLE-RELATIONAL-UNITS#Intake 001 — Self-Identity · Limit · Objective Internality · Confession · World|Intake 001]]` **extends** the inner-horizon and limit reading. The late quilt's user-authoritative correction controls this section: **the ouroboros is read toroidally; the hole belongs to Anuttara/Paramaśiva/#0, while Māyā is the measure-field wound around it rather than the hole itself.**

## The whole image

The ouroboros first appears to the eye as a snake closing upon itself: head meets tail and a line becomes a ring. That apparent circle is indispensable and insufficient. The snake is not merely a line whose ends happen to touch. It has a body, an inside and outside, a mouth through which what is other becomes what nourishes the body, and an opening around which the closed figure is organised. Its act is simultaneously return and metabolism: what goes out becomes what comes in; what is taken in changes the thing that takes it in; the returned path is not the untouched point from which it began.

The project's **trickster** enters at the moment the eye lets the visible circumference stand for the whole. The ring passes itself off as circle or sphere — a closed perfection whose centre can be treated as a point or whose interior can be imagined as filled — while the operative opening disappears from the account. The trick is not that the circumference is false. It is that a true visible determination becomes falsely exhaustive when the absence through which it is organised is read as nothing relevant.

The torus makes the missing relation exact. Its surface and its hole are inseparable in the determination of the form even though the hole never becomes another patch of surface. Close the handle and the topology changes. A loop may close on the torus while its lift remains displaced on the infinite cover; local return can therefore coexist with retained traversal-history. The form comes home without cancelling the path by which it came home.

This is the whole the ouroboros needs in the project. The mouth is not merely an emblem of endless recurrence; it is the operative aperture through which the body can take in, transform and return what it is not. Self-relation remains alive because the whole does not consume the opening into positive content.

## Matheme and the `4+2` appointment

The exact mathematical torus remains a distinct Matheme carrier:

```text
T² = R² / Z²
χ(T²) = 0
π₁(T²) ≅ Z × Z
```

The project's broader QL appointment reads the toroidal whole through the two implicate poles and four explicate relations already generated by `0/1 = 4+2`. The late correction sharpens the image:

```text
#0
hole · unobjectifiable centre · originating condition
        ↓
#1–#4
winding / differentiated surface relations
        ↓
#5
achieved whole · circulation · returned form
        ↓
5→0
surface returns to the opening its identity presupposed
```

This is an authored cross-register relation, not a claim that the ancient ouroboros encoded modern algebraic topology or QL. The mathematical result establishes its own exact torus operations; the Mytheme lets those operations become lived and psychologically consequential.

## Māyā, the winding and the trick

The distinction from Māyā is essential. **Māyā is not the absent centre.** In the mature tattvic reading Māyā is Śakti's power of finite articulation: the measure-field, patterning and contraction through which a local surface/world becomes definite around what cannot itself become one more item of that surface.

Necessary limitation is therefore not the trickster's lie. Without bounded winding there is no determinate path, no local identity and no world in which a return can occur. The fall happens one order later:

```text
finite winding becomes a real form
        ↓
its opening disappears from its own account
        ↓
the formed surface performs as self-grounding whole
        ↓
local closure is mistaken for absolute closure
```

**Hybris is the trick succeeding at the level of measure:** the bounded form forgets that its very identity depends upon what it cannot convert into bounded content.

## Jung / Neumann / individuation seam

The inherited Jungian and Neumannian round/uroboric material remains source-bearing psychic history. The project's toroidal appointment must not be retrojected into those authors as though they supplied the topology. Its gain is a correction to the *operation* the project needs from the image: individuation is not an ego becoming a perfect closed sphere. The ego, complexes, persona, archetypal agencies and inherited psychic formations remain differentiated; the wider Self-relation prevents any local formation from becoming the whole.

The torus therefore **figures** differentiated indivisibility: the local surface becomes more coherent by retaining relation to an unfilled condition, not by sealing that condition away. `[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/diaphaneity|Diaphaneity]]` and `[[submission-package/essay/section-rooms/arguments/08-deferential-intelligence|Deferential Intelligence]]` later give epistemic forms to the same return.

## What full recovery changes

A compressed “ouroboros = eternal return” loses precisely what this project needs. The whole image carries mouth, metabolism, inside/outside, return, opening, apparent circle and toroidal depth together. It shows why **closure and wholeness are not synonyms** and why an absent condition can be structurally present without becoming a positive object.

For native 018, the ouroboros/torus/trickster should therefore remain one whole Mytheme with at least three explicitly separated relations:

- historical/psychological ouroboros and round-image source work;
- exact mathematical torus operations;
- the project's authored trickster/toroidal appointment and `4+2` return.

**Source debt:** recover the exact historical ouroboros carriers actually intended for publication; keep Neumann's own wording and stadial office distinct; keep standard topology sources separate from the QL reading. None of those debts weakens the current authorial relation.

slices.text: # Neumann — The Origins and History of Consciousness (1954) ## Bibliographic identity Erich Neumann's *The Origins and History of Consciousness*, translated from the German by R. F. C. Hull, was first published in English by Princeton University Press in 1954 (Bollingen Series XLV); the German original, *Ursprungsgeschichte des Bewusstseins*, appeared in 1949. **Consulted edition (in hand, 2026-08-05):** the Princeton Classics reissue, Princeton University Press, 2014, paperback, ISBN 978-0-691-16359-8. This is the same Hull translation and retains Jung's foreword. It is a direct reissue of the 1954 Bollingen text; pagination is assumed to reproduce the 1954 layout, but that equivalence must be confirmed against the physical copy before page-located citation. The publisher record (press.princeton.edu) corroborates edition, series, translation, and foreword; the 1954 first-edition record is corroborated by Open Library and national-library catalogue data (accessed 2026-07-16). ## Chicago 18 forms **Full note (consulted edition):** Erich Neumann, *The Origins and History of Consciousness*, trans. R. F. C. Hull, foreword by C. G. Jung, Princeton Classics ed. (Princeton, NJ: Princeton University Press, 2014), {page}. **Shortened note:** Neumann, *Origins and History of Consciousness*, {page}. **Bibliography (consulted edition):** Neumann, Erich. *The Origins and History of Consciousness*. Translated by R. F. C. Hull. Foreword by C. G. Jung. Princeton Classics ed. Princeton, NJ: Princeton University Press, 2014. Originally published in German, 1949; first English edition, 1954. **First English edition (historical record):** Neumann, Erich. *The Origins and History of Consciousness*. Translated by R. F. C. Hull. Bollingen Series XLV. Princeton, NJ: Princeton University Press, 1954. ## Source scholarship Neumann's work is the post-Jungian historical morphology of ego formation: a phylogenetic account in which the individual ego's development recapitulates the history of consciousness as it is carried in myth. The mythic sequence — uroboros → Great Mother → separation of the world parents → birth of the hero → slaying of the mother → slaying of the father → transformation → liberation of the captive — is read as the progressive differentiation of ego-consciousness from the maternal-unconscious ground. Part II maps the same sequence onto the historical stages of ego-consciousness proper. Relevant operations for this essay: - **The uroboros** — the self-containing round, the pre-egoic psychic whole that holds both parents in one figure; the psyche's own image of the undifferentiated condition before the cut. - **The Great Mother** — the maternal uroboros as the first object-face of the unconscious; the archetype's split into good/bad mother. - **The separation of the world parents** — the first differentiation of the primordial couple (Father Heaven / Mother Earth); the principle of opposites born from the one round. The split of the archetype into good and evil figures (the two parents, the twins) belongs to this same movement. - **The hero** — the evolving ego-consciousness; the hero's slayings (of the mother, of the father) are the ego's achieved differentiations, and his descent/return is the relation back through the ground it left. - **The transformation stage** — consciousness opening beyond the ego-hero toward the transpersonal; the inner counterpart of the ego's outward victories. - **The ascent of consciousness and the species-name (p. 16, lead)** — consciousness as the "unnatural" thing in nature, specific to the species that "has justly styled himself Homo sapiens"; the struggle between the specifically human and the universally natural constitutes the history of conscious development. Transcription pending collation against the physical 2014 copy. ## Resonance map (candidates — the harmonisation pass weighs them, not this file)

### 1. Uroboros -> the torus made imaginal
The self-containing round, both parents in one, the whole before the cut. This is the torus's mythic face: the whole that stays whole by keeping its opening open. The uroboros bites its own tail -> the torus's hole is not another patch of surface -> the round that contains its own return. Our *hole/*whole* false cognate gets its exact topological force from this image.
- Locus: Part I ch. I (The Uroboros); ch. II (uroboros with phallus — the round carrying the father's mark).
- Essay-side: [[Antykathera-Essay-Work/submission-package/essay/section-rooms/arguments/17-toroidal-circulation-arche-topos|Toroidal Circulation — Arche-Topos]], quilt §3 · #29 (Topology/Music), §4 · #33 (Complexio/Quaternity/Senarius), [[Antykathera-Essay-Work/submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/bimba-pratibimba|Bimba–Pratibimba]] (indivisibility of hole and surface, prior to circulation).

### 2. World parents -> 0/1; the rotundum and the phallus; 1/0 as the Son's relation back
The separation of the world parents is the first differentiation: one round splits into Father Heaven / Mother Earth. Read in QL: the maternal round is the uncounted `0` (rotundum — the alchemical round, the undifferentiated whole), the father's upright manifestation is the `1` (phallus — the determinate one), and the slash IS the separation of the parents — a cut that still relates. `1/0` is the Son's relation back: the hero's return through the maternal ground he left (slaying of the mother -> descent -> the captive released). `0/1 = 1/0` as one relation read both ways: the parents are a relation, not a fixed hierarchy — the world parents ARE the parent relation.
- Locus: Part I ch. III (Separation of the World Parents); ch. IV–VI (birth/slayings); ch. VIII (liberation — the return).
- Essay-side: [[Antykathera-Essay-Work/submission-package/essay/section-rooms/arguments/03-two-logics-and-sym-ballein|Two Logics and Sym-Ballein]], quilt §2 · #19–20, [[Antykathera-Essay-Work/submission-package/essay/section-rooms/arguments/19-two-ones-mono-poly-matheme|Two Ones / Mono–Poly Matheme]].

### 3. Good/evil twins -> diaballein: "/" vs "-/+"
The archetype splits into good and evil figures — the two mothers, the two fathers, the divine and the demonic twin. This is the psychological form of our dia-ballein grammar: the pure `/` keeps the cut as relation (the twins still share one ground); the collapse into `(-1)+/-(+1)` turns the twins into enemy-gods — annihilation or arrogation, the satanic thread we treat as real (see chang notes p. 84). Neumann gives the mythematic body to the difference between polarity and duality.
- Locus: Part I ch. II (good/bad mother); ch. VI (the two fathers); the brothers/twins motifs throughout the hero cycle.
- Essay-side: quilt §2 · #20 (Dia-Ballein), [[Antykathera-Essay-Work/submission-package/essay/section-rooms/arguments/03-two-logics-and-sym-ballein|Two Logics]], the evil/satanic register per [[Chang Chung-yuan — Tao: A New Way of Thinking (2014)|Chang notes]] p. 84.

### 4. Stadial consciousness -> Gebser's series (phylogenetic recapitulation)
Neumann's mythic stages (uroboros -> Great Mother -> world parents -> hero -> transformation -> liberation) are the history of consciousness recapitulated in every ego. Gebser's structures (archaic -> magical -> mythical -> mental -> integral) are the parallel series. Read through and alongside: Neumann gives the psychic morphology, Gebser the structural diaphaneity; the hero's mental-rational achievement opens into the transpersonal exactly where Gebser's mental opens into the integral. Operational homology, not identity — and Gebser still needs his own house before any quotation.
- Locus: Part I whole; Part II (the historical stages of ego-consciousness).
- Essay-side: quilt §4 · #35 (Apollo Through Dionysus), §5→0 (Gebserian diaphaneity/mutation), [[Antykathera-Essay-Work/submission-package/essay/section-rooms/arguments/20-advent-zero-subject-integral-logic|Advent — Zero, Subject, Integral Logic]]; P5 – Gebser write-up in Epi Paper Write-ups.
- Page __:

### 5. The Great Mother -> the Tao as Mother
Neumann's maternal uroboros is the psyche's figure of the source that gives birth to all forms and never stops holding them: Tao Te Ching's Mother (ch. 1, "the mother of all things"; ch. 6, the valley spirit/mysterious female; ch. 25, "I do not know its name, I call it Tao... Mother of all things"; ch. 52, "having known the mother, know the child"). The Great Mother's two faces — nourishing and terrible — are the Tao's own doubleness: giving birth and devouring return. And our terminal Motherhood (candidate 08, the planetary return given a body) has its archetypal depth here.
- Locus: Part I ch. II (The Great Mother).
- Essay-side: [[Chang Chung-yuan — Tao: A New Way of Thinking (2014)]], quilt Tao layer §7, quilt §5→0 · #48 (Motherhood/AHI/Planetary Return).
- Page __:

### 6. Myth on a topological substrate -> Lacan + QL's core imputation
Neumann's whole method is that myth is the psyche's self-projection — the collective unconscious objectified as mythic image. That is the psychological half of our claim: what the psyche expresses as mythological content stands on a formal substrate. Lacan gives the other half in his topological mathemes (the torus, the Möbius, the cross-cap, the Borromean knot — the unconscious structured like a language, but also like a surface). QL's core imputation: the substrate is a topological formalism that ensures right relation — harmonia — and Neumann's mythic stages are its mythemic record. Neumann is the depth-psychological witness to the claim that Lacan formalised and QL derives.
- Locus: the work's governing method (Introduction; the stage-chapters as myth-morphology).
